name: Carniadactylus
isnote: Separated from Eudimorphodon (as E. rosenfeldi) in 2009; placed in Campylognathoidea/Eudimorphodontidae by different authors. Relationships of Triassic pterosaurs remain unstable.
sum: Small Late Triassic (Norian) pterosaur from northern Italy with complex multi-cusped teeth. The specimen once named “Bergamodactylus” is now included in it.
wsnote: Holotype indicates about 70 cm; the paratype is a third smaller.
holotype: MFSN 1797 — near Udine, Friuli, Italy (Dolomia di Forni).
material: Partial skeleton with parts of skull and lower jaws, lacking the tail; paratype MPUM 6009 (Calcari di Zorzino, Lombardy) is an almost complete skeleton, largely as impression.
biology: Multi-cusped teeth with little wear suggest a diet different from that of Eudimorphodon, probably softer prey such as insects.
author: Dalla Vecchia 2009

formations.formation: Dolomia di Forni / Calcari di Zorzino
